types.embedding_query_text: TechnologyCompany: A company that specializes in the development and manufacture of technology products Also called Tech Firm, IT Company, Software Company. Examples: Google, Amazon, Meta, Apple.

chosen_type.label: TechnologyCompany
chosen_type.definition: A company that specializes in the development and manufacture of technology products
chosen_type.justification: No existing schema.org type fits the definition and mentions

candidates.label: MovingCompany
candidates.comment: A MovingCompany is a local business that provides services for relocating belongings. Also called relocation service, removal company, movers. Examples: U-Haul, Two Men and a Truck, local moving service. Distinct from HomeAndConstructionBusiness, which is a broader category for home-related services.

candidates.label: TechArticle
candidates.comment: An article providing technical information, such as how-to guides, troubleshooting steps, or specifications. Also called technical guide, how-to article, procedural document, specification. Examples: an article on 'How to install Linux', a troubleshooting guide for a software error, a specification document for a new API.

candidates.label: ComputerStore
candidates.comment: A local business specializing in the retail sale of computers and related equipment. Also called PC store, electronics store, computer shop. Examples: Best Buy, Apple Store, a local computer repair and sales shop, Micro Center. Distinct from Store, which is a general retail establishment.

candidates.label: SoftwareApplication
candidates.comment: A computer program designed to perform specific tasks for a user. Also called application, app, computer program, software. Examples: Microsoft Word, Adobe Photoshop, a mobile game, a web browser.

candidates.label: ElectronicsStore
candidates.comment: An ElectronicsStore is a Store that sells electronic goods. Also called tech shop, gadget retailer, consumer electronics store. Examples: Best Buy, Apple Store, a local computer shop, a mobile phone retailer.

types.embedding_query_text: GovernmentOrganization: An organization that is responsible for governing a country or region Also called Government Agency, Regulatory Body, Administrative Organization. Examples: European Union, EU.

candidates.label: GovernmentOrganization
candidates.comment: A GovernmentOrganization is an organization or agency that is part of a governmental body. Also called public sector entity, state agency, governmental body. Examples: Department of Defense, Environmental Protection Agency, National Institutes of Health, local city council.

candidates.label: SportsOrganization
candidates.comment: A general category for organizations involved in sports, including teams, governing bodies, and associations. Also called athletic organization, sports body, sports group. Examples: the NBA, a local youth soccer league, the International Olympic Committee.

candidates.label: NewsMediaOrganization
candidates.comment: A NewsMediaOrganization is an organization that produces and disseminates news, such as a newspaper or TV station. Also called news agency, media outlet, journalistic organization. Examples: The New York Times, BBC News, CNN. Distinct from Organization, which is a broader category for any type of organization.

candidates.label: EducationalOrganization
candidates.comment: An EducationalOrganization is a CivicStructure that provides education. Also called learning institution, academic body, school. Examples: A university, a high school, a vocational college, a research institute.

candidates.label: MedicalOrganization
candidates.comment: An organization, physical or virtual, operating in the medical domain, such as a hospital or clinic. Also called healthcare organization, medical institution, health system. Examples: "Mayo Clinic", "World Health Organization", "Doctors Without Borders". Distinct from Organization, which is a broader category for any group.

types.embedding_query_text: OperatingSystem: A software that manages computer hardware resources and provides a platform for running applications Also called OS, Software Platform, Computer System. Examples: Android.

chosen_type.label: OperatingSystem
chosen_type.justification: Exact match for the OIE type and mentions

candidates.label: OperatingSystem
candidates.comment: An OperatingSystem, as a SoftwareApplication, is system software that manages computer hardware and software resources. Also called OS, system software, platform. Examples: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android. Distinct from SoftwareApplication, which is a general application program.

candidates.label: RuntimePlatform
candidates.comment: A specialized software environment providing the necessary infrastructure, libraries, and services for executing a program. Also called execution environment, software platform, runtime environment, operating system. Examples: Java Virtual Machine (JVM), Node.js runtime, .NET Common Language Runtime (CLR), Python interpreter.

candidates.label: LibrarySystem
candidates.comment: A LibrarySystem is an organization representing a collaborative network or system among several libraries. Also called library consortium, library network, regional library system. Examples: a state library system, a university library consortium, a public library district. Distinct from Library, which is a single physical or organizational entity.

candidates.label: AnatomicalSystem
candidates.comment: An AnatomicalSystem is a MedicalEntity comprising a group of anatomical structures that function together to perform a specific task. Also called organ system, biological system, body system. Examples: The circulatory system, the digestive system, the nervous system, the skeletal system. Distinct from AnatomicalStructure, which is an individual part of the body.

candidates.label: DigitalPlatformEnumeration
candidates.comment: An enumeration listing common technology platforms, used to specify where an action or content is available. Also called Technology platform, software platform, operating system, device type. Examples: iOS, Android, Web, Desktop, Console. Distinct from SoftwareApplication, which is the application itself, not the platform it runs on.

types.embedding_query_text: SearchEngine: A software system that is designed to retrieve and rank online content in response to user queries Also called Web Search Engine, Information Retrieval System, Query Engine. Examples: Google Search.

chosen_type.label: SearchEngine
chosen_type.definition: A software system that is designed to retrieve and rank online content in response to user queries
chosen_type.justification: No existing schema.org type specifically matches the definition and mentions

candidates.label: SearchResultsPage
candidates.comment: A web page displaying the results of a search query. Also called search results, SERP, query results page. Examples: Google search results page, Amazon product search results, a library catalog search page.

candidates.label: SearchAction
candidates.comment: The act of looking for an object or information, often using a search engine or database. Also called searching, querying, looking up, seeking. Examples: typing a query into Google, searching for a file on a computer, looking up a contact in a directory. Distinct from FindAction, which is the result of a search, not the act itself.

candidates.label: UserPlusOnes
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of giving a "+1" endorsement, typically on Google+ or similar platforms. Also called user endorsement, +1, social recommendation. Examples: a user giving a +1 to a web page, endorsing a business, recommending content.

candidates.label: WebSite
candidates.comment: A collection of related web pages and other items, typically served from a single domain. Also called website, internet site, web presence. Examples: schema.org, Wikipedia, The New York Times website.

candidates.label: UserInteraction
candidates.comment: An outdated general type representing any interaction a user has with a web page or content. Also called user activity, user engagement, web interaction. Examples: a user clicking a link, submitting a form, scrolling a page.

types.embedding_query_text: WebBrowser: A software application that allows users to access and view web pages Also called Internet Browser, Web Client, Browser Software. Examples: Chrome.

chosen_type.label: WebBrowser
chosen_type.definition: A software application that allows users to access and view web pages
chosen_type.justification: No existing schema.org type exactly fits the definition and mentions

candidates.label: WebApplication
candidates.comment: A software application that runs on a web server and is accessed by users via a web browser. Also called web app, online application, browser-based application. Examples: Gmail, Google Docs, Facebook.

candidates.label: WebPage
candidates.comment: A single document or resource accessible via a web browser, typically part of a larger website. Also called web document, HTML page, internet page. Examples: a product page on an e-commerce site, a news article page, a contact us page.

candidates.label: WebAPI
candidates.comment: An application programming interface that is accessible over web or internet technologies. Also called web service, API, REST API. Examples: the Google Maps API, the Twitter API, a weather data API.

candidates.label: UserPageVisits
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of visiting a web page. Also called page view, web visit, browsing activity. Examples: a user navigating to a product page, visiting a news article, browsing a website.

candidates.label: WPHeader
candidates.comment: The top section of a web page, typically containing the site's logo, main navigation, and branding elements. Also called page header, website header, site top. Examples: a website's logo and main menu bar, a search bar at the top of a page, a site title.

types.embedding_query_text: ParentCompany: A company that owns or controls one or more subsidiary companies Also called Holding Company, Conglomerate, Corporate Parent. Examples: Alphabet.

chosen_type.label: Corporation
chosen_type.justification: Best fit among candidates for a parent company

candidates.label: MovingCompany
candidates.comment: A MovingCompany is a local business that provides services for relocating belongings. Also called relocation service, removal company, movers. Examples: U-Haul, Two Men and a Truck, local moving service. Distinct from HomeAndConstructionBusiness, which is a broader category for home-related services.

candidates.label: Corporation
candidates.comment: A Corporation is a legal entity separate from its owners, typically formed for business purposes. Also called company, incorporated business, limited company. Examples: Apple Inc., Google LLC, Microsoft Corporation, Coca-Cola Company. Distinct from Cooperative, which is an organization owned and operated by its members for their mutual benefit.

candidates.label: SingleFamilyResidence
candidates.comment: A type of house designed to be occupied by one family, typically detached from other homes. Also called detached house, single-family home, private residence. Examples: a suburban house with a yard, a standalone cottage, a bungalow.

candidates.label: ChildCare
candidates.comment: A local business providing care and supervision for children. Also called daycare center, nursery school, preschool, creche. Examples: Bright Horizons, a local family daycare, a Montessori preschool.

candidates.label: LocalBusiness
candidates.comment: A specific physical business or a branch of an organization that serves a local community. Also called local company, neighborhood business, regional enterprise. Examples: a local restaurant, a bank branch, a medical clinic, a bowling alley, a grocery store. Distinct from Organization, which is a broader category for any group of people with a particular purpose.

types.embedding_query_text: JudicialBody: An organization that is responsible for interpreting and applying the law Also called Court, Tribunal, Judiciary. Examples: Court of Justice, General Court, EU Court of Justice.

chosen_type.label: JudicialBody
chosen_type.definition: An organization that is responsible for interpreting and applying the law
chosen_type.justification: No existing schema.org type matches the definition and mentions

candidates.label: Courthouse
candidates.comment: A Courthouse is a government building where legal cases are heard and judicial proceedings take place. Also called court building, hall of justice, judicial building. Examples: Supreme Court of the United States, Old Bailey, local county courthouse.

candidates.label: LegalService
candidates.comment: A LegalService is a local business that provides legally-oriented services, advice, and representation. Also called law firm, legal practice, attorney service. Examples: a corporate law firm, a family law attorney, a public defender's office.

candidates.label: PoliticalParty
candidates.comment: A PoliticalParty is an Organization formed to contest elections and hold power in government. Also called political movement, party. Examples: Democratic Party, Republican Party, Labour Party, Conservative Party.

candidates.label: Attorney
candidates.comment: An Attorney is a LegalService professional who practices law, providing legal advice and representation. Also called lawyer, legal counsel, barrister, solicitor. Examples: a criminal defense attorney, a corporate lawyer, a family law solicitor, a public defender. Distinct from LegalService, which is the broader category of services provided by legal professionals.

candidates.label: LegalValueLevel
candidates.comment: LegalValueLevel is an enumeration of possible levels for the legal validity or authority of a legislation. Also called legislative authority level, legal hierarchy, law's binding power. Examples: 'Primary', 'Secondary', 'Tertiary', 'Advisory'.

types.embedding_query_text: GovernmentAgency: An organization that is responsible for carrying out a specific function or set of functions on behalf of a government Also called Regulatory Agency, Administrative Agency, Government Department. Examples: European Commission.

chosen_type.label: GovernmentOrganization
chosen_type.justification: Best match among candidates for a government agency

candidates.label: GovernmentOrganization
candidates.comment: A GovernmentOrganization is an organization or agency that is part of a governmental body. Also called public sector entity, state agency, governmental body. Examples: Department of Defense, Environmental Protection Agency, National Institutes of Health, local city council.

candidates.label: FundingAgency
candidates.comment: A FundingAgency is an Organization that implements FundingSchemes and manages the granting process for projects and activities. Also called grant agency, funding body, research council. Examples: National Institutes of Health (NIH), European Research Council (ERC), Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation.

candidates.label: TravelAgency
candidates.comment: A local business that assists individuals and groups in planning and booking travel arrangements. Also called travel agent, tour operator, booking agency. Examples: Expedia, a local independent travel agency, a corporate travel management company.

candidates.label: GovernmentService
candidates.comment: A GovernmentService is an intangible service provided by a government organization to the public. Also called public service, state-provided service, municipal offering. Examples: food stamps program, veterans benefits, public education, waste collection.

candidates.label: GovernmentOffice
candidates.comment: A GovernmentOffice is a local business representing a specific governmental agency or department. Also called public agency office, state department branch, municipal service center. Examples: IRS office, DMV office, local planning department, social security office. Distinct from GovernmentBuilding, which is the physical structure that may contain multiple offices.

types.embedding_query_text: Politician: A person who is involved in politics, especially as a holder of public office Also called Public Official, Government Leader, Elected Representative. Examples: President Trump, Emmanuel Macron, Donald Trump, French President.

chosen_type.label: Person
chosen_type.justification: Best fit for a politician, which is an individual

candidates.label: PoliticalParty
candidates.comment: A PoliticalParty is an Organization formed to contest elections and hold power in government. Also called political movement, party. Examples: Democratic Party, Republican Party, Labour Party, Conservative Party.

candidates.label: PublicToilet
candidates.comment: A PublicToilet is a CivicStructure containing one or more toilets available for use by the general public, customers, or employees. Also called public restroom, public convenience, washroom. Examples: a toilet in a park, a restroom in a shopping mall, a public toilet facility at a train station, a highway rest stop bathroom.

candidates.label: GovernmentOffice
candidates.comment: A GovernmentOffice is a local business representing a specific governmental agency or department. Also called public agency office, state department branch, municipal service center. Examples: IRS office, DMV office, local planning department, social security office. Distinct from GovernmentBuilding, which is the physical structure that may contain multiple offices.

candidates.label: Person
candidates.comment: A Person is an individual human being, whether alive, dead, undead, or fictional. Also called individual, human, character. Examples: John Doe, Albert Einstein, Sherlock Holmes. Distinct from Organization, which is a group of people.

candidates.label: State
candidates.comment: A major administrative division of a country, such as a state or province. Also called province, region, territory, commonwealth. Examples: California, Ontario, Bavaria, Texas.

types.embedding_query_text: Country: A nation with its own government, occupying a defined territory Also called Nation, State, Sovereign State. Examples: United States, France, UK, Spain.

chosen_type.label: Country
chosen_type.justification: Exact match for the OIE type and mentions

candidates.label: Country
candidates.comment: A Country is a sovereign state or nation, representing a primary administrative division of the Earth's surface. Also called nation, state, sovereign state, realm. Examples: United States, Canada, France, Japan, Brazil.

candidates.label: State
candidates.comment: A major administrative division of a country, such as a state or province. Also called province, region, territory, commonwealth. Examples: California, Ontario, Bavaria, Texas.

candidates.label: Embassy
candidates.comment: An Embassy is a GovernmentBuilding representing the diplomatic mission of one country in another. Also called consulate, diplomatic mission, high commission. Examples: The U.S. Embassy in London, the French Embassy in Washington D.C., a country's consulate general.

candidates.label: SingleFamilyResidence
candidates.comment: A type of house designed to be occupied by one family, typically detached from other homes. Also called detached house, single-family home, private residence. Examples: a suburban house with a yard, a standalone cottage, a bungalow.

candidates.label: DefenceEstablishment
candidates.comment: A government building or civic structure primarily used for military or national defense purposes. Also called Military base, army base, naval base, air force station. Examples: The Pentagon, Fort Bragg, Pearl Harbor Naval Shipyard, Royal Air Force Lakenheath. Distinct from GovernmentBuilding, which is a broader category for any government facility.

chosen_type.label: Industry
chosen_type.definition: A group of companies that produce goods or services in a specific sector
chosen_type.justification: No existing schema.org type fits the broad concept of an industry

candidates.label: SoftwareApplication
candidates.comment: A computer program designed to perform specific tasks for a user. Also called application, app, computer program, software. Examples: Microsoft Word, Adobe Photoshop, a mobile game, a web browser.

candidates.label: DigitalPlatformEnumeration
candidates.comment: An enumeration listing common technology platforms, used to specify where an action or content is available. Also called Technology platform, software platform, operating system, device type. Examples: iOS, Android, Web, Desktop, Console. Distinct from SoftwareApplication, which is the application itself, not the platform it runs on.

candidates.label: CreativeWorkSeason
candidates.comment: A CreativeWorkSeason is a distinct period or installment within a larger media series, such as a television show, radio program, or video game. Also called TV season, media season, series season, broadcast season. Examples: "Game of Thrones Season 8," "The Crown Season 4," "The Mandalorian Season 2." Distinct from CreativeWorkSeries, which is the entire collection of seasons or related works.

candidates.label: OnlineBusiness
candidates.comment: An OnlineBusiness is a particular business that operates primarily or entirely online. Also called e-business, internet business, digital enterprise. Examples: an e-commerce site, an online travel agency, a virtual doctor's office. Distinct from LocalBusiness, which has a physical presence.

candidates.label: APIReference
candidates.comment: APIReference, as a TechArticle under CreativeWork, provides documentation for application programming interfaces. Also called API documentation, developer reference, programming interface guide. Examples: Google Maps API documentation, Stripe API reference, Python `requests` library documentation.
